verdict: Passed independent review. The recorded evidence supports all three MSH-38 acceptance criteria with no remaining material harness, product or evidence finding. MSH-39 remains a separate milestone closure review.
scope: Independent read-only source and artifact assessment, including actual remote Windows/Linux GUI evidence and separately sourced macOS CUA reports. This reviewer did not operate a new local Windows/Linux desktop or concurrent macOS CUA session.

acceptance_evidence.AC1: Actual apt-installed normal Linux host/engine identities match package smoke. Windows normal and QA NSIS installations have exact source, installer, executable and runtime identities. Final macOS normal/QA bundle hashes were recomputed from actual current bundles. macOS source reuse is explicit; product paths are unchanged from 4e1e9d4 through 01865e9 and integrated 2f0e4cee.
acceptance_evidence.AC2: Linux and Windows each pass all six independently launched normal/recovery/promotion/claim/capacity/synthetic phases. Every phase records native Quit, the specific guard action and host/engine absence before teardown, with no failure-cleanup event substituted. Exact normal archives preserve three observations and a one-event historical prefix; capacity archives preserve all 256 observations. Separate macOS play/analysis/recovery/Save/Open/history/Resume/outcome/synthetic reports and focused status/capacity corrections retain their own provenance.
acceptance_evidence.AC3: Normal package instrumentation checks, locked workflow and pinned external drivers, reproducible native launch/install instructions, raw screenshots/DOM/native events, full original reports and selected immutable originals support the claims. Prior failed attempts remain failed. Windows-final retains 49 original files, excluding installers and redundant images/logs.

independent_checks: All 65 original Windows GUI-file hashes recomputed; all 49 retained originals match original artifact bytes. Normal host/engine match package smoke, and normal/QA source and installer manifests match.

All 48 retained Linux file hashes match. Its observed normal executable paths are actual /usr/bin installations with package-matching hashes; all six pre-teardown shutdown proofs are ordered after native Quit and guard dispatch.
All recorded files in macos-current, macos-status, macos-capacity-focus and macos-final-normal match hashes. Current actual normal and QA host/engine binaries match their final corresponding reports.

Representative raw Windows and Linux historical, outcome, recovery, capacity, synthetic and native-menu images inspected. Capacity explanations are fully visible; final Windows 21 native capture events have no exact-engine console or foreground error.

01865e9 terminal verifier changes reviewed: transport closure is recognized only after native Quit, specific guard and resolved final click dispatch; actual process absence is still mandatory. Startup retry is confined to bounded driver readiness. Phase failure remains nonzero; cleanup residuals abort further phases and durable reports survive cleanup errors.
GitHub API independently confirms desktop run 40234257669 and Rust run 40234257686 completed successfully on Linux, Windows and macOS, both at exact reviewed integrated source.
limits: Results establish the recorded Windows Server 2022 interactive desktop, Linux X11/Xvfb with recorded compositing override and macOS 27.0.1 arm64 environments; they do not establish every OS/compositor configuration.
Screen-reader audio, formal accessibility certification, actual Dock clicking and release signing are not claimed.
Windows final Quit uses actual native mouse-menu selection. Earlier Ctrl+Q automation failure has no established cause; keyboard Quit success is not claimed.
Earlier macOS journeys are reused only for unaffected behavior with original source/package identities. This review does not replace MSH-39.
